company_name: FUJIFILM Electronic Materials Taiwan Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential materials and chemicals used in semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: FUJIFILM Electronic Materials Taiwan Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive range of materials and chemicals crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. Their portfolio includes photoresists, polyimides, thin film systems, and high-purity chemicals, supporting advanced semiconductor fabrication processes.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company operates in Taiwan, focusing on providing materials and chemicals for the local semiconductor industry.
